svg.title: AegisLand: Nemotron selects the evidence, local code decides
svg.desc: Saved OpenCV simulation traces, which are disclosed prior work, are projected into a bounded evidence window. NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory may select one cited event and one allowed check. Local code rejects malformed or uncited output and evaluates the recorded fact. A no-model deterministic baseline reviews the same records. The source-linked workbench shows video, the original source line, approval state and execution flags. Attempt 004 made one bounded live request that returned HTTP 200, finished with stop and passed citation validation for line 39. No flight command is ever issued.

g.text: AegisLand — Nemotron picks the evidence, local code decides
Nebius Token Factory · NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super · strict citation validation · no flight commands
Small projection, full trace hash kept
Strict JSON · citation must match line + ID
Video seek · original source line · approval state · execution flag
Invalid or uncited output rejected · review JSON export
Cited line 39 (c71390b01d39) · execution_claim · citation validation PASS
Attempts 001–003 preserved unchanged · no retries · recorded evidence, not a live endpoint
Synthetic simulation only. One successful review is not model accuracy, flight certification or a production-safety claim.
